contentList.content: I'm sure there'll be more where that came from.
Go on, shoo with you. I'm quite capable of keeping myself amused these days...
And they are overjoyed to see you, I'm quite certain.
Blueberries. Thought I had a sale. You look tired, Harper.
I'm something much worse.
Heh, I was thinking the same of you. You pick me up whenever I'm down - often literally.
But of course. I can't think of anyone better to let loose on a room of impressionable apprentices...
You might help me with the title, though. I'm considering 'The Hero and Me.' What do you think?
I always knew you could do it. I always knew that together, we could do anything.
Just joking. I'm sure after all we've been through, you know your limitations better than anyone.
Gods. Like clockwork. They'll be on us soon - but there's just enough time.
Every moment we spend together is a joy. And it so happens that someone else has joined the family celebration.
Speak if you wish. But I will not speak in return.
I hope there's more where that came from.
You can thank me by not blundering into any more world-ending mischiefs for the next decade or three. Ta-ta.
Like a rare vintage... bittersweet to taste so infrequently, yet always worth the wait.
You're the person Wyll's hunting, aren't you?
Until then, my suffering must continue.
No, I think it's the end. What happened to the man I once loved?
Gale, I love you, but you can't seriously enjoy our life in the Hells.
Hhune Mausoleum
Toril belongs to all of us. I bow to no one - and most certainly not to you.
You know, I miss that, actually.
*And besides - this brain before you - its endorphins are in a joyous flow.*
A deluge of bone.
And it looks like life at your lover's side is suiting you...
'Sword Coast Couriers'
End... me... please.
Nothing special!? If that is so, then Boo is naught but a brown and base rodent.
Strike me and die, a failed warrior forgotten by your people.
It's your decision, Karlach. You have to choose. Wyll will go with you. Zariel won't be able to touch you.
No, what are you doing? I won't - you can't... No... Please...
You must be Tara. It's a pleasure to meet you.
Move Forwards
*He requested your attendance in Faerun - a chance to reflect on your triumph over the Absolute.*
Rebels swarm to my cause, and even if it takes centuries, I will reclaim my House in Menzoberranzan, and make the Spider-Queen bleed.
Change the subject.
Not great, honestly.
It is the gods who almost brought doom to your world. I was merely a witness to their conspiracy.
The Emperor and I reformed the Knights of the Shield. It is now a formidable force.
Avernus has proven, ahem, lively - but at least I have Karlach by my side. Her laugh parts the clouds.
They don't - they just wing it.
I did what felt right. Did you, when you chose to become the 'Vampire Ascendant'?
I have been tempering myself in battle across the Astral Sea, weakening the lich queen's grip on the throne with every thrust of my blade.
The work of the Absolute, surely...?
Father's very well, and back in his element - commanding the Flaming Fist with as brave a heart as ever.
Are you? Withers and I have a regular correspondence. He's joined me and Mrs Dekarios for luncheon on more than one occasion.
Lae'zel and I have been fighting for the Comet Prince - the lich queen shall soon fall.
Despite myself, I did miss you.
What's this 'protocol for revivification' you mentioned?
I found the love of my life. I'd say I'm pretty happy.
You've been to Limbo? Does this mean you mean to ally with the githzerai?
You're polite to ask when I must reek of brimstone. Been carving my way through Avernus with Karlach.
My life as a Duke is one of bargains, diplomacy, and limited time to enjoy the successes.
Hear No Evil Bear
This world isn't the same without you by my side.
Swirling
Avernus is my hunting ground now, but at least I have Karlach for company.
Contemplate the symbol of Lathander in your hand.
You want my people divided so that we're not a threat to your ambitions.
Oh, terribly sorry, but you mistake me, my friend. I'm only accepting complimentary feedback at this time.

My ally,
Inefficient as written communication is, it will suffice to cover the distance between our minds these days. I write to express my regret that I will not attend your celebration - though I thank you for thinking of me. I have not forgotten you. As I move to restore my influence I shall be sure to call upon you when the need arises, and I hope that you will respond to such a call. Ours was a very beneficial partnership, and I see no need to curtail further opportunities to collaborate.

Your friend,
The Emperor
Have you heard word from Orpheus since his departure?
I may not have the moral high ground when it comes to betraying trust, but right now, I see everything I've been trying to escape in you.
Thou flickerest in the dark - but with mine keen eye, I hath scryed thee.
Lady Shar's blessings to you. Or perhaps you don't need them - you look well.
All well and good, but what about you? I want to hear what you've been up to.
We mean to slay every last sarth and kith'rak. Perhaps the Blade of Avernus would care to join us.
Oh come on, you loved it. I'll wager I'll overhear you telling that to someone else before the night is out.
*It was an invitation you could not turn down, for tonight, you will gather with the friends and allies who stood with you against the Absolute.*
Mizora's note of farewell. It smells faintly of sulphur.
Well now I'm going to have to do that, aren't I? You're a bad influence, you know.
I'm not sure I deserve any of those titles.
We seek new allies for our cause - the githzerai. Together, we will be an unstoppable force.
Given the atrocities the Fist committed under Gortash, I expected her to thrash every last one. But she didn't do so much as scold them.
Return to Character Creation
C'mere you goon.
Poke at your rotted toothhole.
I say we sneak in under cover of night. We slit every last throat and you feed until your belly's full.
Good. Our victory is most certain.
It seems your report was good, W'wargaz.
*But it seems your Father has other ideas.*
Oh I don't know - have you tried juggling them?
Avoiding you lot like the plague. Zariel's got her sights set on me. I don't want to drag you into my nonsense.
I still love you way too much to let you follow me to that pit. But I can't say I'm not delighted you offered.
You defied me, Wizard of Waterdeep, and you paid the price.
Oh. Well, no matter. Dinner alone can be every bit as enjoyable as with company.
I've missed you, Wyll.
Down below. Here's the key.
I must be careful to not overindulge tonight, lest I lose control and slip into bear form...
If you'd rather waste your time with them, you're entirely welcome to.
Of course. Mortals are meant to worship and obey. What other role might they possibly play in the life of a god?
Not with that sort of attitude, I don't.
Not to mention the mightiest magic you can muster and the sharpest swords you can forge.
What's it like? All that power at your fingertips? All those prayers to answer?
Scalpel
I, uh - I'll have to take your word for it, but I won't question it.
Well, his magical ghost is still here, if that's what you mean.
*A letter written in a frail hand interrupted your adventures.*
Nothing but allies, I always told myself. A necessary partnership. But in spite of every strained word, every barbed glance -
|I appretiate the offer, but I have many others events with my name on the guest list. I might gracious enough to get you onto one of those lists if you give me the crown. Now.|
Zhak vo'n'fynh duj. Scorching hot as ever - but not too hot, praise Withers.
When Vlaakith is deposed at last, I'm coming home to you. You have my word.
I thought watching you slay Vlaakith's hunters in the cliffs of Sword's Teeth might be the month's pinnacle.
Crashing: Plunging
Gods. Sometimes I really question what we've both become.
I'm on a crusade against the Hells - it's as tough as it sounds.
I'd see my rivals humbled - jealous of my mastery of the Weave.
If you say so.
You're off the mark. To stalk and to feed? You can't imagine a finer pleasure.
A sharp whiff of gathered allium waters the eyes of any who stand above this crate too long.
Hellfire Steel Watcher Titan
Are you trying to be funny?
I do. Unlike your Sharrans, I strive to live in the light.
Kiss her.
Nimbus
Question Mark A
Slain Ooze
Green
Waukeentide is to start soon in Waterdeep, as I understand it. You are due a hometown celebration - a gust of bright colours among familiar streets.
Rebuilding Baldur's Gate. Playing Duke is as all-consuming a role as being the Blade. And Mizora isn't shy about bending my ear...
X
That is troubling. Just as great tapestries begin with a single stitch, the most treacherous plots begin with a few whispered words.
Stormshore Tabernacle
Letter from Voss
Tell me every. Little. Detail.
I've just been trying to serve Lady Shar, however I can.
A githyanki raised in isolation. His blood boils like his kin's, but their ways are foreign.
If in doubt, I can always lie. We've been slaying dragons and making love atop piles of gold.
Withers has plucked your spirit briefly from beyond the grave to observe this party - but only observe.
Quite an atmosphere. I would not have presumed Withers to have a festive touch.
If you are ever interested in a trip to Elysium, I can put in a word for you.
A dog-eared copy of the Baldur's Mouth Gazette.
You carry the aura of Netheril about you. Is this what the power of Karsus has done to you?
You've never been far from my mind. You're braver than all of Vlaakith's forces combined.
Embrace him.
Sounds very cosy. I can't wait to warm myself under a blanket with you, next to the fireplace.
Only then canst their empty forms be preserved - neatly stored in mine wardrobe til thou hast need of them.
White
You almost sound like you want to go adventuring again...
Divine Performance: Streets and Faces
So this is what freedom feels like. Gods, I've missed it.
Mmm, yes. Shy is indeed not a word I'd reach for, when it comes to her. I'm glad the city has you as a steadying influence - just don't solve all its problems, or I'll be short of new recruits.
*A reprieve from the Blood War, a few hours of respite with the stars above, and good company to cheer you.*
So. Our friend made the Absolute, and led the Bhaal cult? Boo will have words about this... But we can fix it. We fixed it before.
I'd rather just be alone with you, honestly.
Well, there he is. Gale, in all his glory. I hope you're happy.
I've missed you, man. Like, I've really missed you. And you're so... clean.
Reveal the infinitely sharp and wicked form of your patron for a fleeting moment.
Who knows! Maybe I can run like this indefinitely. But... maybe not.
So you gave up on dethroning Mystra? Doesn't sound so ambitious to me.
It's good to see you doing so well, Wyll. You always were my hero, and now you're rebuilding the city I love.
I've slaughtered myriad Vlaakith loyalists. I have full confidence in our victory.
- seeing Grand Duke Wyll Ravengard brings me even more pleasure than taking a royal inquisitor's head.
Blood Splatter 'Pow!'
Don't worry, friend! I'll be sure to send your royalties by post, once the manuscript's published. I'm certain I've your address around here somewhere.
Do you really think Menyar-Ag-Gith will help us destroy Vlaakith?
It truly is splendid to see everyone gathered together again, if only for a night. I hope the sun does not make haste to rise on us.
Become a monster, and I'll destroy you as I have so many others.
I am ambition incarnate. As indistinguishable from that most potent sensation as Mystra herself is from the Weave. And word is spreading.
Incredible story. I wish I'd been there to see it play out.
Good luck, Lae'zel.
I could ask you the same. Why not return to your home?
Running
Perhaps Wyll and I can give the lecture together.
Tonight, he is safe among people I proudly call friends.
We need that power. Just need to get closer...
Then your adventuring days are not behind you. That is good. You are young yet, and these Realms are wide and full of wonder.
I couldn't agree more. Lady Shar's holy work is all-consuming - I doubt I'd manage without a feather bed to turn to.
It's good to see you too.
*But you had nothing to fear. This was the one message you had hoped to receive - an invitation to meet with your friends and allies.*
It led to an isle of cracked rock in Avernus floating amid a molten sea. The orthon stood heaving, breath like brimstone and ash.
I've missed you too. You showed me that even in one who walks in the shadows might still shine her own light.
Now? Now you must rest. For the moment that engine of yours is fixed, I doubt you'll be getting very much sleep at all.
*Tonight you will meet with your friends and allies, those who stood with you in the fight against the Absolute, and you will remember.*
Tell me you bring good news.
Beloved No More: Minsc Slain in Service of the Absolute!
Someone of your prowess should really be following the God of Ambition, if I can be so bold as to suggest it.
Inert Astral Prism
You deserve it more than anyone. You saved Baldur's Gate - all of Faerûn!
I may have volunteered you for something, if you'll forgive me. Might your new community have room for a well-behaved owlbear?
I never got your name.
What have you been up to since last we met?
Moon
I wish I could share the enthusiasm.
Wh-what was that?!
And you are the reason he survived the appetites of the tadpole for so long.
She grants me her divine power, yes. At times I wonder if I am truly deserving of them.
My ambitions are rather, well, illegal. And involve the tragic but entirely natural deaths of some very high ranking patriars...
I'm not sure I want to know the answer - but why was there poison on your lips?
A summonable maul granted by a warlock's patron. Its surface crackles with interdimensional energy.
I offer it freely. Do with it as you wish.
Well, not this world, exactly, but a world.
Arachnid Compulsion
Innkeep Braid
Worth it, I'd say. I missed this place. This - ahem - 'Fay-run'.
I hear you have a letter for me.
Very well then... how are you?
No, this is all me, I swear.

I... have not had true confidantes for some time. The Shadow Curse robbed me of almost all my peers, and replaced them with the weight of responsibility. Perhaps that caused me to gild undeserving memories of my youth.
Sure, rub it in why don't you...
*An invitation to a celebration for those who stood against the Absolute.*
I apologise for my sudden departure before - my people needed me.
You haven't heard the latest tales of my heroics?
Then the architects of Baldur's Gate lack ambition. Had they grander vision, a greater city would rise from the ashes.
Nor would I.
You will claim the Crown of Karsus. It is your right. Your destiny.
*This was just the stroke of luck you needed. Life is looking up.*
Well, soldier. Here we are.

Since the timely end of Raphael's reign, I've gone back to Mephistopheles' Palace in Cania. Many of his Father's court are celebrating the demise of my little brat - behind closed doors. And I'm making a fortune selling evenings in his form now there is no contract binding me to secrecy. Rather tasteless to desire a dead man like that, even amongst devilkind, isn't it?

Unsurprisingly, you've proven quite popular bedwarming the denizens of the ice-hells as well. Undoubtedly, you've felt the echoes of ecstasy when I turn into you, yes? Many satisfied hellspawn. I was with a gelugon the other night who was rather taken by how your surface-flesh shivered pushed up against a glacier.

Here are some other reviews of your body my patrons have asked me to forward to you:

'So rare to find a not-forked tongue in these parts! 5/5.'

'You really should have asked for the nails to be trimmed before memorizing this form... 2/5.'

'It gets frostbite too quickly, and is unsuitable to exhibitionism in this Hell. 3/5'

I hope you're enjoying pleasure's kick - your favourite Incubus.
Still, having him there has been incredible. You really can get through anything with someone you love at your side.
Gale Laugh Emoji
I thought so too. The doctor will keep a light on, I'm sure.
My body's fine, but my soul is hurt - I thought you an adventurer of taste!
Now you fight in the Hells, where there is little to be gained, and much to be lost.
I've been healing. Learning. Finding my place in the world.
It always led Mizora to me - let's see if we can make it take us to her. It's past time for her old pet to sink in his fangs.
Please - I already know. You went to save a friend. Our friend. Your actions require neither justification nor apology.
But I am glad you came - and I genuinely mean that. An evening like this would not be the same without you.
128 imps, 42 dretch, 6 balor, and one particularly feisty abyssal chicken.
Not all cities can be as beautiful as Evereska. Baldur's Gate is itself. That is what matters.
Almost a shame we're with company - I'd be tempted to let you whisk me away someplace quiet.
I may be a Grand Duke. But I promise, I am still the same Wyll you always knew, old friend.
It's done. I've made my choice, Halsin, and I choose you.
You have turned from a queen, and I from a goddess. We are alike - let's face the onslaught together.
I'm glad to hear you say so; days spent bent over books are rarely conducive to a healthy glow or an ache-free back.
I've mostly been hiding, making sure Cazador can't find me.
A duck whittled out of wood. It smells of the deep forest.
And I'm glad you've found a love of your own. We both deserve that.
Ambition? That tends to land people in an early grave. Or a well-deserved coffin, in Cazador's case.
*The buffet table at this party bears pie, punch and cocktail sausages.*
They really are still close...
Oh, I've been so good!
Ah, soldier. How glad I am to see you again. I'd started to wonder if I ever would.
Hide Unseen
Tombstone
In any case, I am glad you made it - tonight is not to be missed. Tonight is for celebrating.
Let us test that theory.
The city's future looks brilliant indeed.
You must be eager to speak to some of the others. I shall be fine - do not allow me to keep you.
No - believe me, you shouldn't have. That place is fucking horrible. I wouldn't wish it on you - on anyone.
I'm afraid you have another child to deal with. Minsc's been captured by the Zhentarim.
He is lost. A shame - he could have proved a great ally to Orpheus.
It's wonderful to see you, Volo. How have you been.
We'll make sure you're well-fed, my dear. And perhaps I'll pick up something warm on the way home, too.
Want to play fetch?
I'd see the Hells filled in with flowers, and my old boss Gortash on his hands and knees tending them for eternity.
I've studied Bhaalian history - if you've got any more allies from the last Crisis, I'd like to meet them.
Haven't you any ambitions, Tara? I could help you, you know.
I'm my own person now. It feels wonderful.
Beg your patron to aid the tadpole in its battle.
A varied diet is indeed the key to a long life.
*The victory that enabled the war against Vlaakith's tyranny. You cannot be there in person, but you shall be there nonetheless.*
You're an illithid now - new worlds are yours to explore, for as long as you still live.
I am pleased to hear it. For all our sakes.
And our little hatchling? Is he safe?
Karlach and I have been exploring the Hells together, finding each and every infernal beast that wants to kill us.
We mean to slay every last sarth and kith'rak. I thought perhaps you'd care to join us.
Yes, I've seen it. The city pulling together, under their new Grand Duke's leadership. You've been busy.
If you pray to me during battle, I might aid you.
I've missed you, Wyll.
Trust that your queen will see past your illithid form. Speak the Rite of Ascension.
Thou art where thou must be - until thou goest where thou must go.
Feathered Hero of Baldur's Gate
*One night, he tells you that these last six months of happy memories are the counterweight to two hundred years of misery.*
Perhaps that is so for you, but for me? It may be that a peaceful life after so many years of tumult has made me sentimental.
To you.
Worn Bubble Tail A
My oath is to the rule of law. Not even the Absolute is above the law.
Begging
*Not enough graves. Never enough.*
I'm doing what I can. No more or less than that.
I stayed for love. I do not regret it.
Of a sort. But I miss the open skies and open roads.
Stained with imp guts and warmed from within by hot, sweaty toes.
Writhing Souls
We can stop at the infirmary on the way back to the cottage.
*Those who made your war against Vlaakith's tyranny possible. You cannot join them in person, but you shall be with them again nonetheless.*
Of course she does.
*One day, you receive a letter, passed to you by a stranger who bows with deference.*
I know what happened to you Gale. Raphael told me.
Exactly what a devil would say.
All my life, I've been caught between two warring goddesses. Time to plot a new course.
But I'm glad to see the world has treated you well - you've earned it. We both have, in fact.
Chk.
Wyll Kiss Emoji
Sanctuary of Loss
Lae'zel has an army - she is hardly alone. And she certainly does not need you to protect her.
There was a time I thought you'd seen another path for yourself. I thought perhaps the camaraderie we shared would sway you toward a gentler path.
Careful. My acolytes won't take too kindly to that. Nor will I.
I have to say, I'm quite grateful to just be 'Gale' for the evening.
My dear - do you mean to say the ravishing creature with the Orin mask I met just last night wasn't you?
If Gale's not comfortable, I'm not interested.
How could it not with you to guide the reconstruction?
Now he's back in his element - commanding the Flaming Fist with as brave a heart as ever, and with nary a scolding or lashing.
Display Case
So I have heard - just be sure to keep it far from Lady Shar's holy work. Even the sharpest blade can be dulled against her power.
And to you, Karlach.
Not as kind as they've been to you.
I'd love to, but I'm leaving Faerûn after tonight.
This is a dangerous object. I'm not sure we should be playing with it.
The wyrm is dead, but his spirit lives within me. I've pledged to follow in your footsteps, for the good of the Gate.
Avernus is my hunting ground now, but at least I have Karlach for company.
Tell me what you've been up to.
I won't be killing Ethel. In fact, I've made a deal with her.
I must say, you're looking very well. I'd hazard a guess that life without a tadpole in your skull is rather suiting you.
I was attacked first!
Well, she got what she deserved.
Do you want to see the others? Say 'hello'?
Hear me, thou heroes, wastrels, friends. I have waited long to tell you these words.
Hast thou e'er pondered: what is the value of one mortal life?
Nothing. Forget I said anything.
The runes are the key! Cazador is using them to leech the spawns' power.
Wait, it's all coming back to me. I know who you are - what an honour!
Turn Undead
I've just been trying to serve Lady Shar, however I can.
Would you mind demolishing Bhaal's domain while you're at it? Just if you're passing through.
You've done a lot of killing for a warlock without his powers.
I'll be back soon - enjoy yourself.
That can't have been easy. I'm glad you've stayed upright, anyway.
And what of the egg you took? Has it hatched?
The Upper City. Those who dine well, make fine dinners.
Anyway, I know it's real. I know we made it. I just wish I could go back in time and reassure the old me that it would all work out. But enough introspection - this is a party.
With thee, she couldst do anything.
This is your choice to make, Lae'zel, not mine. I entrust it to you.
Really? What's kept you so busy?
Have you ever thought about coming back to Faerûn?
Perhaps Shadowheart and I can give the lecture together.
*The Netherbrain is defeated, Faerûn is saved, but where you should feel peace you feel only the orb. Restless. Hungry. Yearning.*
I won't keep you to myself for too long, but while I have you - I want to say thank you for encouraging me to attend this evening.
Of course. What wizard wouldn't benefit from the wisdom my god has to offer?
Standing F
Unfortunately, he fell into company that turned his gaze toward foolishness. Yes, I mean you.

Rather than surrender, Ketheric threw himself into a pit - and was transormed into an avatar of the dark deity Myrkul. After the creature was destroyed, Ketheric returned to his original form. We should search his body for the stone he used to control the brain.
How far does your power extend? Can you let me walk in the sun again?
Oh, my life's much the same as before. Plotting Cazador's eventual, painful destruction...
I've spread my wings since we last met. Got a few more spells in my arsenal, a few more miles under my boots...
No matter how far away I may be, Waterdeep will always be first in my heart.
Forgetting something?
Part of me was relieved you left so quickly after the battle. I felt... ashamed. Like I'd lost everything, just as you claimed your victory. I didn't want you to see me like that.
True. We are spectacular, after all.
That's a shame, but what'll you do.
I've taken a breather in Limbo, after myriad battles in the Astral Plane.
In Avernus, there is no end to them. The demons I've disintegrated, the devilkin I've bled - the stories I could tell.
If that day ever comes, I look forward to seeing how much the wine and good living has dulled your blade.
Very Handsome Shirt
I was taught that any man who spoke out of line, or above his lowly station, should be punished. I called that justice.
Too right. We could fill rivers with all the blood we've spilled.
Do you still want to hear what I have been up to?
If only. I've got my hands more than full in Avernus.
Happy. Gonna get pets. Gonna play. Gonna live with nice lady!
Do you have regrets? How have you been living since we last saw one another?
I hope the sand takes its time slipping through the hourglass - I don't want tonight to end too soon.
You're a sentimental creature at heart, you know that?
Remain silent and wait for Jaheira's signal.
*One such night, your reveries are interrupted by an embarrassed apprentice, delivering an urgent message, written in a frail hand.*
To all those we lost on the way.
And where better to celebrate our good fortune? An old haunt with old friends.
It would have feasted on that impressive mind of his, and all of his talent would have been snuffed out forever.
This hand has been played by the cult.
You are right. My choice, my life. I will know true liberation.
You are many things, Gale. The man who became a god, the Wizard of Waterdeep... but a keeper of secrets you are not.
And she was mine.
Ha - of course not. I am teasing you.
Of course you could leave them! You owe your people nothing.
What you say of her fate is true. I have known it since I was a hatchling. Somewhere deep within.
I'm sorry, Gale. I'm not coming.
Never mind a perfectly good set of clothes. This cloth stains at the slightest drop of blood. It's awful.
We killed so many together...
Open for me, and the hag will pay for her crimes. You have my word.
I... I know, and I can help. I've made contact with an assassin, name of Artemis, a killer of killers. Certain arrangements can be made.
I will never understand why people thank one another for making honest observations.
Skills Without Proficiency
You should visit some time. Now that I'm a man of influence, I'm sure we could satisfy any cravings you had.
Toggle Model
He has developed something of a taste for tadpole, and is displeased by the diet I have placed him on. But no better cure than the company of friends!
A little. But I have missed you.
I'm getting tired... I might just go to bed.
Interesting. If the chance should arise for you to thwart Shar in some way, assume you have my support.
*A reprieve from the Blood War, a few hours of respite with the stars above, and good company to cheer you.*
I'm sorry I haven't visited.
I've missed travelling with you. You were a pleasure to be around.
Hm. I'm not noticing anything special.

After reading 'The Legend of Ansur', we discovered the great wyrm Ansur resides in a secret lair called the Wyrmway. The entrance is apparently located somewhere within Wyrm's Rock Prison, and the notes inside it hint that opening the way involves lightning sparks and torches.
The chance to see life through your eyes, as well as my own - it's been everything I hoped it would be.
Crate of Melons
I refuse to believe you still don't know my name after all we went through together.
No transformation or ascension can remove that stench of ambitious desperation.
I can serve the Coast from Waterdeep - and I can keep an eye on you while I'm at it.
*The last nerve of a wobbling block snaps. You don't need those molars, meat-thing that you are!*
The city just won't die. Like so many of us.
And you, Lae'zel - a child, an unascended - would snatch my glory for herself.
Countless tales have begun with a roaming adventurer - I am sure I shall keep the children enthralled for years to come with your exploits. Thank you.
Sun
Square Bubble Tail A
Oh you're far too cunning to fall for that. Consider Lady Shar's cloister your safe sanctuary, for as long as it answers to me.
Pick Lock
Your father is on the council? Then Mizora kept her promise.
'Claugiyliamatar'. 'Clog-ee-myalarfer'. 'Cloff-a-mother-f...' Whatever - let's call it Old Gnawbone.

As requested, here are my final wishes for once Kelemvor has summoned me. Apologies I could not deliver them in person; my condition is progressing, and I dearly wish to clear my reading backlog while I still can. Precious time is better spent between the pages of a good book than on chores - I'm sure you understand. Beyond that, a simple coffin and pleasant corner of your graveyard is all I ask - that, and that the following be read to the mourners on the day of my burial. Rest assured, they shall grasp its meaning.

To my friends and family,

I know the running joke has been that I'm prone to missing appointments and shirking responsibilities, but behold - I am here as promised, and prepared in advance! I write this knowing it might be the last time I put ink on parchment, so know that every word is true.

Matty, I know we had our ups and downs, true, but I'm glad we parted on an up - it's amazing what rallying to help save the city can do for familial relations. I'll be there at your side for the final battles, even if you cannot see me. Add a few notches to your sword hilt for me, eh? I am blessed to have you as a brother, as is TJ to have you as a father.

TJ, promise me you'll continue to be yourself - keep studying, writing, and working on your music. I'll remain your constant fan, even if you can't see me. Give the rest of the world a chance to see you for who you are. The person I've long been privileged to know.

Sawyer, I'd happily trade every scrap of gold in the Counting House for a few more moments of your company. No matter how dismal the world seemed at times, I always had our friendship to keep me going. I hope you'll bring my goddaughter to visit me from time to time - she has full permission to play atop my grave if she wishes.

Now wipe your tears and find a cosy tavern to share stories about me; I'll never be gone so long as you remember me. And be good, the lot of you, or I'll be back to haunt you!

All my love,
